_readme: Config + allowlists for scripts/check-docs-alignment.mjs (DOC-08). Every allowlist entry carries a reason + owning ledger ID so the discipline stays reviewable. See docs/DOCS_ALIGNMENT.md.

scan.reason: forward declaration; writer lands in Learner Model slice 3

rawRefsAllow.reason: Knowledge Mine word-progress subcollection; no firestore.ts helper by design (FIRESTORE_AUDIT)
Word Wall reads the same Knowledge Mine word-progress subcollection; no helper by design

UX-394 duplicate-children survey asks EVERY family collection whether it holds a document belonging to a duplicate child doc, so the last path segment is a parameter by design. A per-helper list is exactly the hand-picked set Codex round 1 rejected as incomplete (it missed xpLedger's composite event keys, over an irreversible currency record). Completeness is enforced instead by ghostChildDocs.completeness.test.ts, which fails when CLAUDE.md's own Firestore Collections table names a collection PROBED_COLLECTIONS does not, in both directions. Reads only; the one write is a deleteDoc through childrenCollection().

UX-394, Codex round 3: the same survey also probes the subcollections hanging off the duplicate's OWN document (children/{childId}/wordProgress, /transcriptionEvents) — the shape no query over a sibling collection can see, and the worst to miss because Firestore does not delete subcollections with their parent. wordProgress has no firestore.ts helper by design (see the two FIRESTORE_AUDIT entries above), and the path is parameterised by the subcollection name for the same reason the family-level probe is. Read-only; completeness is enforced by ghostChildDocs.completeness.test.ts against CLAUDE.md's own Subcollections list.

_dayWrite_readme: FEAT-114 day-write routing invariant (check 10, HARD). Every write to families/{familyId}/days must route through src/features/today/dayWriteGuard.ts; a raw setDoc/updateDoc/deleteDoc on a days ref anywhere else fails the build. dayWriteAllow lists the (currently none) files with a documented exemption — each needs {file, reason, ledger}. The guard module itself is the sanctioned chokepoint and is skipped by name, not allowlisted.
_resilience_readme: DOC-09 resilience invariants. remoteCallAllow = src/features files whose raw httpsCallable call is deliberately un-guarded (justified exceptions to check 7, SOFT→HARD). imageDownscaleAllow = image file-inputs that legitimately skip in-file downscale — either the downscale lives in an imported handler (pointer in the reason) or the flow genuinely needs the original (sketch/photo). Check 9 (silent-fallback census) has NO allowlist by design — it is report-only and never fails CI.

imageDownscaleAllow.reason: capture routes through useUnifiedCapture.handleUnifiedCapture, which downscales before upload (Today capture pipeline)
upload routes through useFoundationsReview, which downscales before the vision call
chat image upload routes through useShellyChatFlows (compressIfNeeded before uploadBytes)
onAddImage routes through useBook.addImageToPage, which compresses via compressIfNeeded before upload
genuine originals-needed: enhanceSketch reimagines the original scan; downscaling would degrade the source
genuine originals-needed: feature-extraction / photo-transform CF needs the original photo
